name: Close-based 20/10 Turtle with 4x EMA(ATR20) stop
author: Pine user Richard
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Highest/lowest close(20) and (10), ATR(20), EMA(20) of ATR
entry_long: Close > highest close of prior 20 bars (close[1] window) and not already in a trade -> long at close. Stoploss = close - 4 x EMA(ATR(20), 20).
entry_short: Close < lowest close of prior 20 bars -> short.
exit: Exit long when close < stop or close < lowest close of prior 10 bars (lenght/2).
stop_loss: 4 x EMA(ATR(20),20) from entry (script rounds to integer price)
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Uses closing prices for channels, unlike classic Turtle highs/lows. Short exit mirrors: close > stoploss or close > highest close 10. Note the script computes short stoploss with the same minus formula, which looks buggy; verify.
